sources.entry: FnKeyboard - Quick access to function keys from the menu bar. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/kotique123/FnKeyboard) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A lightweight macOS menu-bar app that shows clickable on-screen keycaps for the F1–F12 function keys and triggers their system actions such as brightness, media, and volume.
summary.what_it_does: Lives in the macOS status bar with a keyboard icon and opens a popover that lays out all twelve function keys in a grouped layout resembling a Mac keyboard. Each keycap shows an SF Symbols icon and label, with hover highlight and spring-press animations, and adapts to Dark or Light mode. Clicking a keycap simulates the key through HID or CGEvent so the real system function fires. The app also uses a CGEvent tap to detect which F-keys are physically held down, which requires Accessibility/Input Monitoring permission. Taps are debounced at 200 ms and simulated presses are rate-limited to 150 ms per key.
use_cases: Adjust screen brightness from the menu bar
Control media playback without the keyboard
Change system volume with a mouse click
Trigger function keys on a Mac without using the physical F-row
Access F-key actions on a laptop or external keyboard setup
how_to_run: Download FnKeyboard.app.zip or the DMG from the latest GitHub release, unzip, and move FnKeyboard.app to /Applications
Open the app and grant Input Monitoring when prompted
Build from source: git clone the repo, cd FnKeyboard, chmod +x build.sh, ./build.sh
Create release DMGs with ./build.sh --release or a single-architecture DMG with ./build.sh --dmg
notable: Menu-bar-only app (LSUIElement) with no Dock icon
Clicking a keycap fires the real system function rather than a simulated label
Hardened Runtime with zero entitlement exceptions and no App Sandbox
Build script supports arm64 and x86_64 builds plus DMG creation and Developer ID signing
Only F1–F12 key codes are filtered; the README states no keystrokes are logged or transmitted
caveats: Needs Input Monitoring / Accessibility permission, which grants read access to all keyboard events system-wide
Runs unsandboxed because the CGEvent tap and HID APIs are unavailable inside the App Sandbox
Ad-hoc-signed builds are warned against for distribution; a Developer ID is needed for signed release builds
